cs.t: The 16 I have clears the low low bar gaming laptops have set. My previous laptop was an ASUS G14 and it didn't even take two years for huge problems to appear - particularly throttling. Also the very last firmware update absolutely destroyed power management, making it idle at a crazy 20W. The keyboard in my Framework is weak and I had to replace it, but other components are doing well.

Hopefully this will be taken more seriously in the gaming laptop/productivity market. I'm really glad there's a properly repairable, relatively open high performance laptop. Is there any plans or similar for a 14in GPU enabled (with a decent TGP) laptop? I got a 14in laptop recently and find it very good for a power/perforamnce tradeoff (ASUS G14 or Razer Blade 14). Not to mention the amazing battery life.

I recently put Linux on an Asus G14 and I can't stop thinking about how it's the same size and similar finish and build quality as my 13" MacBook Pro from 2015 but has a GPU and is running Linux and all the hardware worked out of the box (except maybe the built-in mic which I haven't tested) hell I even bought it in store! eat your heart out Tim Apple, the year of the Linux desktop has arrived anyway my point in this comment is DO IT you won't regret it! modern Linux has gotten so good
